name: Tauren
summary: Across central Kalimdor, the tauren are building a home in Mulgore while keeping their old ways. They call themselves shu'halo and honor the Earth Mother, shamanism, and the natural world. Centaur clans nearly destroyed them before they joined Thrall's New Horde. High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof now leads them from Mulgore and Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Nomads of the Barrens
sections.body: For countless generations, the tauren roamed the arid Barrens with the seasons. They hunted the great kodo and listened for the Earth Mother's voice. Then the centaur tribes brought their peaceful wanderings to an end. Born from the tragic union of Zaetar and Princess Theradras, the fierce centaur waged a relentless war against them. Without a fortified homeland, and unwilling to fight without end, the tauren were driven near annihilation.

sections.title: The New Horde and Thunder Bluff
sections.body:
An alliance from across the sea gave the tauren a chance to survive. During the Third War, Cairne Bloodhoof met Warchief Thrall and the orcs who had newly arrived. The leaders recognized a shared honor and longing for their shamanic heritage, and joined forces.

With the Horde's help, the tauren defeated the marauding centaur and claimed Mulgore's sheltered grasslands. Cairne founded Thunder Bluff on Mulgore's windswept mesas. In gratitude, the tauren marched with the Horde to Mount Hyjal and helped turn back the Burning Legion.

sections.title: Spiritual Guardians and Internal Tensions
sections.body:
The tauren bring a peaceful, steadying voice to the Horde. Their mastery of nature and the elements helped revive orcish shamanism. Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem also keeps rare diplomatic and spiritual ties with night elf druids as they investigate growing corruption within the Emerald Dream.

Yet unity among the tribes remains fragile. Most revere Cairne's wisdom, but the xenophobic and ruthless Grimtotem clan lives within Thunder Bluff. Its leader, the scheming elder crone Magatha, secretly plots to seize leadership and steer the shu'halo toward supremacy.

faq.q: Why did the tauren join the Horde?
faq.answer: Ruthless centaur clans nearly wiped out the tauren in the Barrens. During the Third War, Warchief Thrall and his orcs fought beside Cairne Bloodhoof, drove the centaur back, and helped secure Mulgore. Bound by honor and shared spiritual values, Cairne pledged his people's loyalty to the New Horde in gratitude.

High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof leads the tauren and heads the Bloodhoof tribe. Respected for his strength and measured judgment, he unites the tribes from Thunder Bluff, with Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem and Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem assisting him.

The Earth Mother is the central deity of tauren belief. The shu'halo believe she created the world, the sun, and the moon. They honor her through a life attuned to nature's balance, seasonal migration, hunting, and respect for the elements.

faq.q: Why do the tauren hate the centaur?
faq.answer: Centaur hunted the tauren for sport and warred with them for centuries across central Kalimdor. They saw the tauren's peaceful spirituality as weakness, drove them from place to place, and nearly wiped out the shu'halo before the orcs intervened.
Yes. Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem leads the tauren druids, who learn the ways of the wild alongside night elves. Tauren druids are a cornerstone of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Are all tauren loyal to Cairne Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: Most tauren tribes revere Cairne, but the Grimtotem are a bitter exception. Led by Magatha Grimtotem, they believe tauren are superior to all other races and despise Cairne's alliance with the Horde. They quietly work to undermine his peaceful reign.
Tauren train as warriors, hunters, shaman and druids.

angles.text: As shu'halo, your people's ancient nomadic wanderings have given way to a homeland in Mulgore, secured through the brotherhood between Cairne and Thrall.
The tauren give the Horde moral guidance and deep spiritual roots, tempering the aggressive instincts of orcs and trolls with ancient wisdom and honor.
Through Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, tauren druids work alongside the night elves of the Cenarion Circle to heal the land and protect the Emerald Dream.
Tauren shamanic traditions are among Azeroth's oldest. Their teachings helped the orcs rediscover their sacred elemental bonds after the demonic taint of past wars.
